Problem Statement:
Given an integer N, find if it is divisible by 11 
N >= 1 
1 <= No. of digits in N <= 1000 
Input Description:
The only line of input contains an integer N 
Output Description:
Print YES if N is divisible by 11, NO otherwise. 
Explanation:
1331 = 11 * 11 * 11 
Sample Input:
1331 
Sample Output:
YES
